title: Gonda Encounter.
text: The 1982 Gonda Encounter is an ongoing criminal case involving the murder of 13 people including the Deputy Superintendent of police in Gonda district of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. On 5 March 2013 three police personnel were given capital punishment and five others were given life-time imprisonment by the special CBI court in Lucknow.

title: INSAT-1A launched; deactivated in September.
text: INSAT-1A was an Indian communications satellite which formed part of the Indian National Satellite System. Launched in 1982, it was operated in geostationary orbit at a longitude of 74° east.

title: Charan Singh announces retirement from active politics.
text: Chaudhary Charan Singh was an Indian politician, peasant leader, author and an independence activist who briefly served as the prime minister of India from July 1979 to January 1980. Singh was principally known for his land and agricultural reform initiatives, and was Member of Parliament (MP) for Baghpat.

title: Doordarshan begins testing of Color television broadcast in India.
text: Doordarshan), abbreviated as DD, is India's state-owned public television broadcaster. Established by the Union of India on 15-September-1959, it is owned by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and constitutes one of Prasar Bharati's two divisions.

title: Bijon Setu massacre seventeen Ananda Margis were set ablaze at Bijon Setu in Dhakuria in south Kolkata. No one has been convicted of the murders.

title: Government of India announced setting up of a permanent and integrated Indian Naval Academy at Ezhimala (hill, Kannur).
text: The Indian Naval Academy is the defence service training establishment for officer cadre of the Indian Navy and the Indian Coast Guard, located in Ezhimala, Kannur district, Kerala. Situated between Ezhimala hill and the Kavvayi backwaters, INA has a 7-kilometre beachfront on the Laccadive Sea.

title: NABARD established through act of Parliament following B. Sivaraman Committee recommendation.
text: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development is an All India Development Financial Institution (DFI) and an apex regulatory agency and Supervisory Body for overall supervision of Regional Rural Banks, State Cooperative Banks and District Central Cooperative Banks in India. It was established under the NABARD Act 1981 passed by the Parliament of India.

title: Vypeen alcohol poisonings.
text: The Vypin alcohol poisonings killed an estimated 77 people in 1982 in Vypin near Kochi in Indian state of Kerala. Hundreds of people, mostly fish workers and other labourers, drank liquor supplied by several Government-licensed arrack shops.

title: Future Prime Minister of India Manmohan Singh becomes Governor of the Reserve Bank of India
text: Manmohan Singh was an Indian economist, bureaucrat, academician and statesman who served as the prime minister of India from 2004 to 2014. He was the fourth longest-serving prime minister after Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi, and Narendra Modi.

title: 4 December – 9th Asian Games held in Delhi.
text: The 9th Asian Games, also known as Delhi 1982 (Hindi: दिल्ली 1982), were held from 19 November to 4 December 1982, in Delhi, India. 74 Asian and Asian Games records were broken at the event.
